title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway: attackers can knock it offline
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 117 days old, so current versions are being attacked. It affects a product that faces the internet or gives remote access.

category.label: VPN, firewall or gateway
category.why: It sits at the edge of your network and faces the internet, so attackers can reach it directly.
category.doThis: If you have it, patch it today. If you cannot, block access to it from the internet until you can.

summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability which could lead to denial of service.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Aug 29, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

exploitCode.label: a source withheld from the API
